For a 50-person Indian company, I’d shortlist these three current options. Exact airfare/hotel spend is variable, so “total cost” below means the provider/platform cost before travel fares.

Offer	Total cost	Terms to verify
ITILITE
	₹0 subscription; trip/service fee applies	Get the exact per-trip fee, GST treatment, cancellation/change charges and annual commitment in writing. 24/7 support included. 
Itilite

MakeMyTrip myBiz
	₹0 annual subscription; negotiated service fee	Confirm service fee, 1.5% payment-gateway fee, corporate-fare eligibility, cancellation rules and credit terms. 
MakeMyTrip
+1

Navan
	₹0 for Travel for ≤300 employees	Verify India inventory/support, international coverage, GST invoicing and any expense-user charges; enterprise/custom services are separately quoted. 
Navan

Before paying: demand a written quote showing all booking/change/cancellation fees, GST, payment fees, credit period, SLA, 24/7 escalation and exit terms.
